_doc: GAB mic path per benchmark clip. First rule whose gurdwara regex matches (case-insensitive) wins; else the acoustics rule; else 'unknown'. mixer-feed and room-mic are shown with their 50/50 mean as a second view (the user's estimate: Gurdwaras split about half and half; never the headline). Since GAB v1.2 the Fremont hall laptop-mic recordings are GAB-Hard (gab-sets.json tiers), so main GAB kirtan is mixer-feed only and its 50/50 reads 'mixer-feed only'. studio and unknown are shown but stay outside the 50/50. Edit this file when a recording's mic path is confirmed; the scorecard prints the assumption. A rule may carry a 4th element = the manifest acoustics value it requires.

classes.mixer-feed: mixer / broadcast feed straight into the PC (USB from the mixer, livestream audio)
classes.room-mic: room or laptop microphone in the hall (reverb, sangat singing along)
